thinkingSteps.title: Aha insight
thinkingSteps.body: To find all the words from a given list that can be formed by a 2D board of characters, we can use a Trie (prefix tree) to efficiently search for words while traversing the board. We start by building a Trie from the given list of words. Then, we perform a depth-first search (DFS) on the board, checking if the current path forms a valid prefix in the Trie. If it does, we continue the DFS until we find words or reach dead ends.
